verdict.rationale: The pack has no published count of connected institutions and no list of supported countries a founder could check against where their users bank. The only geographic mention is payment rails (Faster Payments in the UK, SEPA in Europe), which describes how payments settle rather than which institutions are reached. Institution-selection screens and per-institution feature flags are adjacent features, not published coverage data.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform documents how many institutions it reaches and where — published coverage numbers and geographies I can check against where my users actually bank
